s.note: Soft plaited egg bread sweetened with honey, glazed golden and scattered with sesame seeds
s.how: Stir 7g dried yeast and 3 tbsp honey into 200ml warm water and leave for 5 minutes until foamy. Add 500g bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 2 eggs and 60ml vegetable oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove for 1 1/2 hours until doubled. Divide into 3, roll into 40cm ropes and plait, tucking the ends under. Prove on a lined tray for 45 minutes. Brush with egg yolk, scatter with 1 tbsp sesame seeds and bake at 190C for 30 minutes until deep golden. Cool for 15 minutes before tearing.

s.note: Pickled herring chopped by hand with egg, apple and red onion, spread thick on dark rye with dill
s.how: Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. On a board, finely chop 300g drained pickled herring fillets, the eggs, 1 peeled green apple and half a small red onion. Mix with 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp caster sugar and plenty of black pepper, then cover and chill for 30 minutes. Spread thickly on 8 slices of dark rye and scatter with chopped dill.

m.note: Thin pancakes rolled around sweet lemon and vanilla cheese, fried golden in butter, with sour cream and warm cherries
m.how: Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs, 375ml milk, a pinch of salt and 30g melted butter to a thin batter and rest for 30 minutes. Beat 400g ricotta, 150g soft cream cheese, 1 egg yolk, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Simmer 400g frozen pitted cherries with 3 tbsp sugar and the lemon juice for 5 minutes, then thicken with 2 tsp cornflour mixed with a little water. Cook 12 thin pancakes in a lightly buttered 20cm pan, on one side only. Put a spoonful of filling on the cooked side of each, fold in the sides and roll into parcels. Fry in 40g butter, seam side down first, until golden on both sides. Serve 3 each with sour cream and the warm cherries.

w.note: Dark, moist honey cake spiced with cinnamon, clove, ginger and orange, topped with toasted almonds
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 23cm square tin. Whisk 3 eggs with 150g brown sugar until thick, then whisk in 250g honey, 125ml vegetable oil and 180ml cooled strong black tea. Whisk in 300g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp each ground cloves and ginger and the zest of 1 orange. Pour into the tin, scatter with 50g flaked almonds and bake for 50 minutes until dark and springy. Cool in the tin for 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

d.n: Samovar glass tea with lemon and cherry jam
d.note: Strong black tea poured into glasses with a slice of lemon, cherry jam and sugar cubes on the side
d.how: Brew 2 tbsp strong loose leaf black tea in a small pot with 250ml boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour a little of the concentrate into 4 heatproof glasses and top up with 750ml boiling water to the strength you like. Serve each with a thin lemon slice, a spoonful of cherry jam to stir in or eat alongside, and 2 sugar cubes.
